s4.electricity.circuits.prompt: What is needed to make a simple circuit work?
choices: a complete loop with a cell and wires
s4.electricity.circuits.answer: a complete loop with a cell and wires
s4.electricity.circuits.explain: A circuit must be a complete loop containing a source such as a cell.

s4.electricity.circuits.prompt: What happens when a switch is open?
choices: the circuit is broken and the component is off
s4.electricity.circuits.answer: the circuit is broken and the component is off
s4.electricity.circuits.hint: An open switch leaves a gap.
s4.electricity.circuits.explain: An open switch breaks the circuit so current cannot flow.

s4.electricity.circuits.prompt: Which material is usually a good electrical conductor?
s4.electricity.circuits.hint: Look at the metal inside many wires.
s4.electricity.circuits.explain: Copper is a metal and conducts electricity well.

s4.electricity.circuits.prompt: What is the job of a cell in a circuit?
choices: to hold the bulb in place
s4.electricity.circuits.hint: It is the source of the push for the current.
s4.electricity.circuits.explain: A cell provides the electrical energy that makes a circuit work.

s4.states.water.prompt: Which state of matter keeps its own shape?
s4.states.water.explain: A solid keeps its own shape, unlike a liquid or gas.

s4.states.water.prompt: What is the change from liquid water to water vapour called?
s4.states.water.hint: It happens when liquid gains heat.
s4.states.water.explain: Evaporation changes a liquid into a gas.

choices: a liquid changes into a solid
a solid changes into a liquid
a gas changes into a liquid
a solid changes into a gas
s4.states.water.answer: a liquid changes into a solid
s4.states.water.explain: Freezing changes a liquid into a solid when it cools.

s4.states.water.prompt: Which state spreads to fill its container?
s4.states.water.hint: Gas particles can move throughout the container.
s4.states.water.explain: A gas spreads out and fills the space available.

s4.digestive.system.hint: Food is chewed and mixed with saliva there.
s4.digestive.system.explain: Digestion begins in the mouth when teeth break food up and saliva starts to act on it.

choices: churns food and mixes it with digestive juices
s4.digestive.system.answer: churns food and mixes it with digestive juices
s4.digestive.system.hint: It is part of the food tube.
s4.digestive.system.explain: The stomach churns food and mixes it with digestive juices.

s4.digestive.system.prompt: What is the small intestine mainly used for?
s4.digestive.system.hint: Nutrients need to enter the bloodstream.
s4.digestive.system.explain: The small intestine absorbs nutrients into the blood.

s4.digestive.system.prompt: Which organ removes water from undigested food?
s4.digestive.system.hint: It comes after the small intestine.
s4.digestive.system.explain: The large intestine absorbs water and forms faeces from waste.
